q: IRFA debits adjusted among Rlys relate to

options.A: Inter change of Rolling stock including Wagons
options.B: Inter change of Rolling stock Excluding Wagons

e: Option B (Inter change of Rolling stock Excluding Wagons) is the correct choice. IRFA debits adjusted among Railways relate to the interchange of rolling stock excluding wagons. The Indian Railway Finance Adjustment (IRFA) mechanism settles inter-railway balances for rolling stock movements other than wagons. Exam point: wagon interchange is settled through a separate mechanism. q: Negotiations with which tenderer should be done after obtaining sanction of competent Authority:?
e: Option B (Lowest Eligible Tenderer-L1) is the correct choice. negotiations are held with the lowest eligible tenderer (L1) after obtaining the sanction of the competent authority. Negotiations with any other tenderer are not permitted as a routine; the L1 principle protects fairness. Exam point: post-tender negotiations are an exception, require prior sanction, and are confined to L1. This provision exists for a practical reason in day-to-day railway working; keeping that practical picture in mind makes the fact far easier to retain than memorising it in isolation.

q: Supplementary estimate is Prepared

options.A: When Exp likely to cross Sanctioned Estimate
options.B: When there is cost escalation due to delay in commencing work after sanction
options.C: To include an item ,which ought to have been included in original estimate

e: To include an item ,which ought to have been included in original estimate — that is the right answer. a supplementary estimate is prepared to include an item which ought to have been included in the original estimate. It corrects omissions in the sanctioned estimate rather than covering cost escalation, which is met by a revised estimate. Exam point: revised estimate covers cost escalation; supplementary estimate covers an omitted item. Notice how precisely the correct option is worded.

q: Lease/Licencing fee on Railway land is credited to
e: Option B is correct: lease/licensing fee on railway land is credited to Abstract Z of earnings. Earnings from railway land are part of sundry earnings accounted under Abstract Z. e: Option A (More advantageous) is the correct choice. the 25 kV AC OHE is more advantageous than the 1500V DC system. q: Power to Re-appropriate fund from one Grant Idemand to other lies with
e: The correct answer is Board. the power to re-appropriate funds from one grant/demand to another lies with the Railway Board. q: Write back adjustments are done

options.A: When assets life period is completed
options.B: At the time of condemnation of an asset
options.C: When asset not used for long time

e: The correct answer is At the time of condemnation of an asset. write-back adjustments are done at the time of condemnation of an asset. The principle behind this is worth grasping, not just memorising: once you understand why the rule is framed this way, the answer follows naturally instead of needing rote recall.

q: Most important check in a contractor bill of works in Accounts is

options.A: Rates and Quantities agree with contractors Agreement
